text_en: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
text_cn: 犹大的子孙：培勒兹、赫兹龙、加尔米、胡尔和芍巴耳。

text_en: Reaiah son of Shobal became the father of Jahath, and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the families of the Zorathites.
text_cn: 芍巴耳的儿子勒阿雅生雅哈特，雅哈特生阿胡买和拉哈得：以上属祚辣家族。

text_en: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi,
text_cn: 以下是厄坦的父亲胡尔的子孙：依次勒耳、依市玛和依德巴士；他们的姊妹名叫哈兹肋耳颇尼。

text_en: and Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
text_cn: 还有革多尔的父亲培奴耳，胡沙的父亲厄则尔：以上是白冷的父亲，厄弗辣大的长子，胡尔的子孙。

text_en: Ashhur father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah;
text_cn: 特科亚的父亲阿市胡尔有两个妻子：赫拉和纳阿辣。

text_en: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
text_cn: 纳阿辣给他生了阿胡仓、赫斐尔、特曼人和阿哈市塔黎人：以上是纳阿辣的儿子。

text_en: The sons of Helah: Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
text_cn: 赫拉的儿子：责勒特、祚哈尔、厄特难和科兹；

text_en: Koz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel son of Harum.
text_cn: 科兹生阿奴布；祚贝巴、雅贝兹和哈戎的儿子阿哈勒尔的家族。

text_en: Jabez was honored more than his brothers; and his mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain. ”
text_cn: 雅贝兹在自己的兄弟中最受尊重；他母亲给他起名叫雅贝兹说：“我在痛苦中生了他。”

text_en: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me and enlarge my border, and that your hand might be with me, and that you would keep me from hurt and harm! ” And God granted what he asked.
text_cn: 雅贝兹呼求了以色列的天主说：“若你真祝福我，求你扩展我的疆域，求你常伸手扶助我，脱免灾难，不受痛苦。”天主就赏赐了他所求的。

text_en: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
text_cn: 叔哈的兄弟革路布生厄舍东的父亲默希尔。

text_en: Eshton became the father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.
text_cn: 厄舍东生贝特辣法、帕色亚和依尔纳哈士的父亲特兴纳，他是刻尼次人厄色隆的兄弟：以上是勒加布人。

text_en: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.
text_cn: 刻纳次的儿子：敖特尼耳和色辣雅；敖特尼耳的儿子：哈塔特和毛诺泰。

text_en: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah; and Seraiah became the father of Joab father of Ge-harashim, so-called because they were artisans.
text_cn: 毛诺泰生敖弗辣；色辣雅生革哈辣史的父亲约阿布；他们原是工匠。

text_en: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the son of Elah: Kenaz.
text_cn: 耶孚（fú)乃的儿子加肋布的儿子：依尔、厄拉和纳罕；厄拉的儿子刻纳次。

text_en: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
text_cn: 雅肋肋耳的儿子：齐弗、齐法、提黎雅和阿撒勒耳。

text_en: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. These are the sons of Bithiah, daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered married; and she conceived and bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah father of Eshtemoa.
text_cn: 厄次辣的儿子：耶特尔、默勒得、厄斐尔和雅隆。彼提雅生米黎盎、沙买和厄市特摩的父亲依市巴。

text_en: And his Judean wife bore Jered father of Gedor, Heber father of Soco, and Jekuthiel father of Zanoah.
text_cn: 他的犹大妻子生革多尔的父亲耶勒得、索哥的父亲赫贝尔和匝诺亚的父亲耶谷提耳：以上是默勒得所娶法郎的女儿彼提雅所生的儿子。

text_en: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
text_cn: 纳罕的姊妹，曷(hé)狄雅的妻子生的儿子：加尔米人刻依拉的父亲和玛阿加人厄市特摩。

text_en: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
text_cn: 史孟的儿子：阿默农、陵纳、本哈南和提隆。依史的儿子：左赫特和本左赫特。

text_en: The sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er father of Lecah, Laadah father of Mareshah, and the families of the guild of linen workers at Beth-ashbea;
text_cn: 犹大的儿子舍拉的儿子：肋加的父亲厄尔、玛勒沙的父亲拉阿达和在贝特阿市贝亚细麻织工的家族；

text_en: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who married into Moab but returned to Lehem (now the records are ancient).
text_cn: 还有约肯、苛则巴人、约阿士和撒辣弗；他们回白冷之前，去摩阿布娶了妻子。【这都是古代的事。】

text_en: These were the potters and inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king in his service.
text_cn: 他们都是陶工，定居乃塔因和革德辣，操此手艺，靠君王居住。

text_en: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
text_cn: 西默盎的儿子：乃慕耳、雅明、雅黎布、则辣黑和沙乌耳。

text_en: Shallum was his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
text_cn: 沙乌耳的儿子沙隆，沙隆的儿子米贝散，米贝散的儿子米市玛。

text_en: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
text_cn: 米市玛的子孙：米市玛的儿子哈慕耳，哈慕耳的儿子匝雇尔，匝雇尔的儿子史米。

text_en: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers did not have many children, nor did all their family multiply like the Judeans.
text_cn: 史米有十六个儿子，六个女儿；但他的兄弟们子女不多，为此他们的家族不如犹大的子孙旺盛。

text_en: They lived in Beer-sheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,
text_cn: 他们住在贝尔舍巴、摩拉达、哈匝尔叔阿耳、

text_en: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
text_cn: 彼耳哈、厄曾、托拉得、

text_en: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
text_cn: 贝突耳、曷尔玛、漆刻拉格、

text_en: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their towns until David became king.
text_cn: 贝特玛尔加波特、哈匝尔稣心、贝特彼黎和沙阿辣因，直到达味王时代，都是他们住的城市，

text_en: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five towns,
text_cn: 和所属的村庄。此外，还有厄坦、阿殷、黎孟、托庚、阿商五城市，

text_en: along with all their villages that were around these towns as far as Baal. These were their settlements. And they kept a genealogical record.
text_cn: 和这些城市四周直到巴耳所属的各村庄：以上是他们居住的地方和族谱。

text_en: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,
text_cn: 默芍巴布、雅默肋客、阿玛责雅的儿子约沙、

text_en: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah son of Seraiah son of Asiel,
text_cn: 约厄耳、耶胡，──耶胡是约史贝雅的儿子，约史贝雅是色辣雅的儿子，色辣雅是阿息耳的儿子；

text_en: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
text_cn: 还有厄里约乃、雅科巴、耶芍哈雅、阿撒雅、阿狄耳、耶息米耳、贝纳雅、

text_en: Ziza son of Shiphi son of Allon son of Jedaiah son of Shimri son of Shemaiah—
text_cn: 齐匝，──齐匝是史非的儿子，史非是阿隆的儿子，阿隆是耶达雅的儿子，耶达雅是史默黎的儿子，史默黎是舍玛雅的儿子：

text_en: these mentioned by name were leaders in their families, and their clans increased greatly.
text_cn: 以上诸人，都是宗族的首领，他们的家族也很兴旺。

text_en: They journeyed to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks,
text_cn: 他们迁往革辣尔关口，直到山谷东面，为羊群找寻牧场。

text_en: where they found rich, good pasture, and the land was very broad, quiet, and peaceful; for the former inhabitants there belonged to Ham.
text_cn: 他们找到了一片很肥沃良好的牧场，广阔、清静、安宁的地方。古时含的后代住在那里。

text_en: These, registered by name, came in the days of King Hezekiah of Judah, and attacked their tents and the Meunim who were found there, and exterminated them to this day, and settled in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.
text_cn: 犹大王希则克雅时代，上述的这些人出征，破坏了当地民族的帐幕，击杀了当地所有的玛红人，将他们消灭直到今日；他们遂居住在他们的地方，因为那里有放羊的牧场。

text_en: And some of them, five hundred men of the Simeonites, went to Mount Seir, having as their leaders Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, sons of Ishi;
text_cn: 西默盎的子孙中，另有五百人出征色依尔山区；依史的儿子培拉提雅、乃阿黎雅、勒法雅和乌齐耳为统率，

text_en: they destroyed the remnant of the Amalekites that had escaped, and they have lived there to this day.
text_cn: 击杀了其余未逃脱的阿玛肋克人；以后他们住在那里，直到今日。
